answer: Escrowed Delay Auction: each new identity must win a timed slot auction, and its escrow unlocks only after the prior slot holder’s escrow clears, forming a serial chain. Attackers pay escalating slot prices plus locked capital for every identity, and parallel registration forces bids up a spiral of waiting costs. Legitimate users amortize one slot like a walnut shell, while bulk buyers face compounding escrow across an orchard of synthetic identities.
